comparison.sourceGraph: Named BLOCK_RECORD 1FF (WF Beam - Imperial) owns extension DICTIONARY 200 with ACAD_SORTENTS entry pointing to SORTENTSTABLE 236. The table has owner 200, reactor 200, and body group 330 block owner 1FF; DXF dictionary uses group 360 for the hard-owned entry. All six referenced entities resolve with owner 1FF.

authority.finding: ObjectARX describes draw-order entity/key associations in a block table record extension dictionary and states that stored pair sequence does not determine draw order.
Sort keys are numeric order values and may no longer identify a database object; they are not object references merely because DXF uses group 5.
The documented DXF body group-330 owner is limited to model/paper space, conflicting with this ODA-emitted named-block example.

decision: ODA preserves the selected association set, numeric keys and the 12-member block ordering on this source, even though it reorders serialized pair entries. This justifies targeted source-wire and selected-output research; one ODA conversion and an ezdxf structural audit do not resolve the named-block DXF documentation conflict or establish an AutoCAD-native open/save/getFullDrawOrder result. Keep production admission and strict whole-source claims closed.
limits: One local AC1024 source and one ODA build; no native AutoCAD semantic inspection, draw-order evaluation or rendering was run.
The sorted six explicit key pairs do not by themselves establish the full resulting draw order of all block entities.
The remaining dynamic-block graph, 19 NOD roots, source wire completeness, failure/retry and staged output closure remain separately unqualified.
Only scratch copies, logs and derivatives were created. No drawing, package or product-source change is committed; /private/tmp artifacts may be ephemeral.
